stem: If a bacterial cell divides every 15 minutes, how many bacteria will be produced in 2 hours?
expl: In 2 hours, there are a total of 2 × 60 = 120 minutes. There will be 120 ÷ 15 = 8 intervals of 15 minutes in 120 minutes, therefore, starting from one bacterial cell, a total of 28 cells, i.e., 256 bacterial cells, will be produced in 2 hours.
